title: Sunday Community Jam @ 2 Feet Brewing
event_description: A drop-in Sunday afternoon jam in a downtown Bangor brewpub where musicians simply show up with instruments and play from 2:00 PM to 5:00 PM.
backline: Acoustic jam; bring your own instrument
event_venue_information:
2 Feet Brewing

2 Feet Brewing is a family-operated brewpub in downtown Bangor. Craft beers are made by Cory Ricker and the pub fare and desserts are made by his wife Nit-Noi using locally sourced ingredients. The taproom also pours hard seltzers.

Atmosphere and Setting

Families and musicians of all ages gather here. A local news feature described the Sunday jam as uniting musicians of all ages which reflects the welcoming approach of the whole taproom.

Sunday Community Jam

Every Sunday from 2:00 PM to 5:00 PM people simply show up with instruments and play. There is no sign-up and no set list which makes it one of the most approachable jams in the Bangor area.

Songwriters Open Mic

Every Tuesday from 5:00 PM to 8:00 PM 2 Feet sets up a mic for songwriters and each performer gets 15 minutes. It is a strong fit for players with a handful of originals who want more room than a typical two-song open mic.

Other Programming

The taproom is listed by Bangor Downtown as a hub for community events.

Good to Know

2 Feet Brewing is located at 80 Columbia St Bangor ME 04401. Hours are Monday through Thursday from 11:00 AM to 8:00 PM and Friday and Saturday from 11:00 AM to 9:00 PM and Sunday from 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM.

title: Irish Session and Open Mic @ Paddy Murphy's Pub
event_description: A Tuesday night at an Irish pub with a live Irish jam from 6:00 PM to 8:00 PM followed by an open mic from 9:00 PM until close.
event_time_plain: 6:00 PM - 8:00 PM (session); 9:00 PM to close (open mic)
event_venue_information:
Paddy Murphy’s Pub

Paddy Murphy’s is an Irish pub in downtown Bangor offering food and drink alongside a steady week of entertainment.

Atmosphere and Setting

The pub has the feel of a classic Irish bar with a mix of session music and karaoke and open mic nights that draw regulars and newcomers alike.

Tuesday Irish Session and Open Mic

Every Tuesday the pub hosts a live Irish jam from 6:00 PM to 8:00 PM followed by an open mic from 9:00 PM until close. Traditional players can join the early session and singers and songwriters can take the mic later in the night.

Other Programming

Monday nights feature karaoke starting at 9:00 PM. The pub has also hosted special holiday nights combining live Irish music and open mic.

Good to Know

Paddy Murphy’s is located at 26 Main St Bangor ME 04401. Confirm start times on the pub’s Facebook page since the schedule is posted there.
